lesson-intro.text: Lunch is served. Burger in front, fries behind, boba on the right, all on one tray. See what overlaps what, then serve up your own.

burger-bun.text: The burger goes down first, front left. Draw its top bun and three seeds.

burger-middle.text: Under the bun go wavy lettuce, then a slice of cheese. Draw its two short ends.

burger-base.text: Then the patty, with a dip for the hanging cheese, and the bottom bun.

boba-cup.text: The boba stands front right. Draw the cup, slanting in toward the bottom.

boba-lid.text: Add the rim band, the dome and the leaning straw.

boba-pearls.text: Five pearls sit in a row at the bottom of the cup.

carton.text: The fries hide behind both. Draw only the parts of the carton you can see.

fries.text: Two fries stand in front, three are tucked behind. Stop each line where it meets something.

tray.text: Slide a tray under everything. Draw its outer edge, then one more line just inside it.

color-big.text: The cup and the seeds are cream. Buns orange, carton red, cheese and fries yellow.

color-rest.text: Patty and pearls brown, lettuce green. Finish the boba: gray dome, blue rim, pink straw.

lesson-outro.text: Tray's up. You drew a whole meal, and that's Food and Treats finished. Time for a real snack.
